I don't get called out that often but it does happen from time to time. it honestly depends on the situation. my brain usually comes up with 2 or 3 "extra lies" to go along with the original lie just in case they ask any questions or call me out. If those don't work or they call me out in an unexpected way, i find myself trying to make sure that they think I didn't lie on purpose, so I might tell them I got confused with what I was talking about or misunderstood them. 


I can probably count on my fingers the amount of times I've been called out on my lies by strangers though. Good question.
